Read a complete, SHA-256-checked Python video tracking export bundle

Source: R/video-bundle-benchmark.R
aqt_video_bundle_import.Rd

The optional PyAV/YOLO/ByteTrack runner emits a frame PTS table, an MOTChallenge tracker table, an exact class-ID sidecar and JSON metadata. All outputs must have the same prefix and match their recorded hashes, row counts, source camera/session, frame origin and class-row keys. This refuses partial, mixed-run and silently reordered sidecar files. The source video/model hashes are recorded but are NOT checked unless the user separately provides those files for independent verification.

Usage

aqt_video_bundle_import(directory, prefix)

Arguments

directory

Directory containing the four completed runner files.

prefix

Safe output prefix passed to the Python video runner.

Value

aqt_video_bundle, with validated 2D tracks, all acquired video frames, class sidecar, local source metadata and support audit. No biological fish classification or camera calibration is certified.
